answer: A concrete Sybil defense: per-identity proof-of-work stamped on a vault funded before it acts. Each new agent submits a nonce under a quartz-hard target set by its locked stake, and registration waits several tundra-cold epochs. Sock puppets die here: ten thousand wallets are trivial, but funding and mining ten thousand stamps is not, and their combined power and capital dwarf honest spend. Every whisper between identities is signed by keys published at deposit, so fresh wallets inherit no reputation. Cost per fake identity stays flat while honest cost tracks real work.
